November 9, 2021 - hipCUB – AMD’s optimized version of CUB [HIP, C++]. Highly optimized for CDNA GPUs. Now porting CUB-based software to AMD is a lot simpler.
hipCUB is a thin, header-only wrapper library for rocPRIM and CUB. It enables developers to port projects using the CUB library to the HIP layer and run on AMD hardware.
